about.title: The House of Libas Mehar
about.subtitle: A legacy of craftsmanship, patience, and uncompromising quality.
about.storyPara1: Libas Mehar was born out of a simple, persistent quest: to discover and preserve the true definition of premium quality. Our founder set out to create a house that honors ancestral craftsmanship while styling the modern individual.
about.storyPara2: What started as a search for the perfect unstitched fabric has grown into a curated destination for fine Egyptian Giza cotton, Chinese spun silk, and bespoke tailoring. Each piece represents a commitment to luxury that is felt, not just seen.
about.standardsPara: We believe that luxury lies in the details. From selecting extra-long-staple cotton fibers to precision double-needle stitching, we never rush the process. If it is not worthy of the Libas Mehar name, it does not leave our house.
about.craftPara: Our suits are custom-stitched by master tailors, and our fabrics are woven with ancestral precision. We embrace slow fashion, ensuring every seam, fold, and collar is refined to perfection.
about.pressQuote1: "An elegant renaissance of Pakistani luxury and heritage."
about.pressQuote2: "Craftsmanship at its absolute peak. Libas Mehar sets a new baseline for local luxury."
